items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Bo Gill tore up that contract and Herman Stark and Owey Madden took Calloway...

ctx.x: And Bo Gill tore up that contract and Herman Stark and Owey Madden took Calloway and put him in the Cotton Club. And the band was a cooperative band and they took the band away from the boys and give it to Calloway and said, 'This is your band.' And they got him signed up --
take the Missourians to Cab Calloway's band.
